title: Relational Co-Adaptation in Emotionally Supportive AI: Tensions in Authentic Emotional Interaction
reasoning: The paper evaluates the ethical implications of human-AI alignment in the context of emotional support, specifically exploring the 'authenticity paradox'. It identifies and analyzes ethical tensions regarding relational autonomy, human connection, and the value systems of various stakeholders that guide AI behavior, proposing 'Bounded Alignment' as an ethical framework for future design.
